request.description:
**EP-SC-014B** · `GET /channel/catalog/summary`

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `channel` |
| Permission | `sc.catalog.view` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `channel-web` |
| Name | نظرة عامة على الكتالوج |

Counts of this channel only. products_change_pct / categories_change_pct / brands_change_pct are integer percent growth versus rows created before the current calendar month (app timezone); null when that earlier count is zero. active_share_pct and stopped_share_pct are shares of products (stopped = status disabled). by_category rolls each product up to its platform root, or to the channel top category when it has none; unassigned products use bucket unassigned. by_brand includes id null name «بدون علامة» when a product has no brand. by_status omits a status whose count is zero (active|disabled|draft). recent_products is the 8 newest; price is the base price in minor units or null. recent_changes is the 8 newest catalog/pricing audit rows for this channel_id; bulk_action is set only for catalog.product.bulk. The product list (EP-SC-014) stays four keys.

**Example response `data`:**
```json
{
    "counts": {
        "products": 2,
        "products_change_pct": null,
        "categories": 1,
        "categories_change_pct": null,
        "brands": 1,
        "brands_change_pct": null,
        "active": 1,
        "active_share_pct": 50,
        "stopped": 1,
        "stopped_share_pct": 50
    },
    "by_category": [
        {
            "bucket": "root",
            "id": 1,
            "name": "غذائية",
            "count": 2
        }
    ],
    "by_brand": [
        {
            "id": 12,
            "name": "الخير",
            "count": 2
        }
